studies.interpretation_warning: Descriptive expression only. Three of eight biological pools are QC REVIEW for Salmon mapping below 60%; the 24 runs are technical repeats, not biological replicates. No differential-expression inference is supported.

Only the prespecified 7-week adult meclonazepam-versus-control contrast is inferential. Five treated 4-week juveniles remain in the fitted ~ condition model by project decision; this does not estimate an age effect. Biological interpretation of individual genes remains provisional.

RESTRICTED_REFIT; TWO_REPLICATES_PER_GROUP; SOURCE_IDENTITY_LIMITATION. Only the 12 approved schistosomulum libraries and three reviewed sex contrasts from the restricted refit are included. Adult and cercaria libraries and contrasts are NOT_EVALUABLE and excluded. Do not substitute the original 20-sample DE results or relabel libraries.

Descriptive meclonazepam time series only: eight time points, one biological library per time point and no parallel control. Expression trends are not statistically supported treatment effects; no DE contrasts are included.

CODING_GENE_SCOPE; REVIEW_4_OF_6. The frozen adult-female 5-azacitidine-versus-control contrast is retained with Salmon mRNA mapping of 34.61–60.83%. Leave-one-out fits support effect stability but do not replace the full fit. Claims are restricted to quantified coding genes; the unquantified read fraction, lncRNAs and drug-target identity are not established.

Descriptive HP1 regional candidates. MACS3 calls are unchanged; nf-core/chipseq 2.1.0 merges overlapping or bookended intervals, retaining candidates with at least one calling library. Single-library and multiple-library evidence remain distinct; shared core requires at least two libraries and does not crop candidate regions. HOMER 4.11 assigns the nearest promoter, including for intergenic regions; this is not proof of regulation. Gene-assignment ambiguity is not assessed because these source executions predate the TSS snapshot. Stage and strain are confounded (cercaria SmVEN; sporocyst SmDFO); biological independence of deposited libraries is not established. FRiP is 0.201–3.161%; the 200 bp extension is operational. Occupancy significance and differential binding were not assessed.

Published descriptive regional catalogs: H3K27me3 broad and H3K4me3 narrow; two deposited IP libraries per sex/stage/mark, with matched Input IDs. This compact publication is not certification of complete upstream QC or a combined terminal run. DB remains HOLD: adult sex/instrument confounding and unresolved source-pool relationships. H3K27me3 strict direct comparison failed for one nearest-gene assignment in each male group (shared TSS, Smp_095580/Smp_341610); original assignments retained and ambiguity not assessed. H3K4me3 preserves assessed and unassessed ambiguity, and IDR <=0.05 is separate evidence, not the annotation catalog. No regulation or occupancy significance is inferred. BAMs, individual peak coordinates and bigWig signals are not published in this compact package. Adult/cercaria RNA from this accession remain excluded; use compatible approved RNA studies without sample pairing.
